title: pyrus commutata
intro: Pyrus commutata, commonly known as the mountain apple or small-leaved pear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its edible fruits, which are rich in health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus commutata include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
